actions.title: Contribute at least $10 in the $WOOD community seed sale
actions.call: participants(address) returns (uint256 totalContributed, uint256 totalAllocated, uint256 totalClaimed)
actions.notes: totalContributed uses 6 decimals (10000000 = $10). The sale enforces $10 minimum and $200 maximum per wallet, USDG only.

actions.title: Seed sale purchase event
actions.event: TokensPurchased(address indexed buyer, address indexed token, uint256 paymentAmount, uint256 woodAmount)
actions.notes: buyer is topic1. paymentAmount uses the payment token's decimals (USDG = 6).

actions.title: Claim unlocked $WOOD from the seed sale
actions.notes: Only possible after the sale is finalized and the owner unlocks a milestone (MilestoneUnlocked(uint256 newUnlockedBps), topic0 0xf474f87806baca4eae88818e5b2f0790521557148b3ca1b56bd6a56d7111c1ae).

actions.title: Make a swap through the Sherwood Router
actions.event: SherwoodSwap(address indexed user, address indexed referrer, address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOut, uint256 feeAmount, address recipient, uint8 venueMask, uint8 legs)
actions.notes: Available only once the SherwoodRouter is deployed; the contract address will be published here. user is topic1. Size a swap in USD from amountIn/amountOut and the token's decimals.

actions.title: Refer a user whose swap goes through the Sherwood Router
actions.notes: The site captures ?ref=<address> and passes it as the referrer argument.
